Until then, premium hikes will keep outpacing wages—regardless of temporary subsidies.

Senator Reed claims Democrats want to "protect your health care," but their track record proves otherwise. For years, D.C. bureaucrats have funneled taxpayer dollars into bloated insurance subsidies while ignoring systemic fraud and price-gouging. The real crisis? Medicaid’s collapse under the weight of illegal immigration—millions added to rolls without contributing, draining resources from citizens.

Until Washington stops prioritizing corporate donors over patients, costs will keep rising. America needs transparency, not another trillion-dollar band-aid.
